title: Vanilla by ItsRomik
description: Client-side Vanilla+ modpack that expands the functional and visual experience
body:
# Vanilla by ItsRomik
![Modpack Vibe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6554b53008b1f5db14c28d149efd7a5e8c936591.jpeg)

## 🌿 The Idea

**Vanilla by ItsRomik** started as a personal modpack made just for me and my friends.  
The goal was simple — show how great **Minecraft** can look and feel with the right **client-side mods**, while keeping the original vanilla gameplay.

This modpack doesn’t try to change Minecraft.  
Instead, it carefully improves the experience with **quality-of-life features, visual enhancements, and performance optimizations**.

The result is a **clean Vanilla+ experience** that feels familiar, but smoother, prettier, and more comfortable to play.

[Creating a custom resource pack](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)
---

## ⚙️ Performance

The modpack includes multiple performance improvements to make the game run **much smoother**:

- 🚀 **Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore** — major FPS and memory optimizations  
- 🌐 **Krypton, Packet Fixer** — network optimizations  
- 👁 **EntityCulling, MoreCulling, SmartParticles** — reduce unnecessary rendering  
- 📦 **ImmediatelyFast** — faster UI rendering  

---

## 🎨 Visual Improvements

Minecraft becomes more alive and atmospheric with many subtle visual upgrades:

- ☁️ **Better Clouds** — beautiful dynamic clouds  
- 🌧 **Particle Rain** and **Particular** — improved particles and weather  
- 💥 **Explosive Enhancement** — new explosion animations  
- 🌬 **Windy** — wind particles in the sky  
- 💡 **LambDynamicLights** — dynamic lighting  
- 🎭 **Entity Model Features** & **Entity Texture Features** — dynamic entity models and textures  

Shader support is also included via **Iris**.

---

## 🧭 Interface & Information

Several mods improve the interface and provide useful gameplay information:

- 📊 **Better Statistics Screen** — expanded statistics  
- 🎯 **Advancements Reloaded** — improved advancements screen  
- 🍎 **AppleSkin** — hunger and saturation information  
- 🔎 **Jade** — information about blocks and entities  
- 📋 **BetterF3** — customizable debug screen  

---

## 🧰 Quality of Life

Many small improvements make everyday gameplay much more comfortable:

- 📦 **Inventory Profiles Next** — inventory sorting and tools  
- 🖱 **Mouse Tweaks** — better inventory mouse controls  
- 📦 **Shulker Box Tooltip** — preview shulker contents  
- 🔍 **Chest Tracker** — search through containers  
- 🔧 **Controlling** — keybind search  

---

## 🗺 Exploration

Navigation and exploration are easier with:

- 🗺 **Xaero's Minimap**  
- 🌍 **Xaero's World Map**  
- 🔭 **Zoomify**  

---

## 🎮 Multiplayer & Social

For playing with friends:

- 🎙 **Simple Voice Chat** — proximity voice chat  
- 😊 **Emotecraft** — player emotes  
- 💬 **Emoji Type** — emojis in chat  
- 👥 **Highlighted Friends** — highlight friends in the player list  

---

## 🧱 Building Tools

Builders also get useful tools:

- 🧩 **Litematica** — schematic holograms  
- 👁 **SchematicPreview** — schematic preview  
- 💡 **Lighty** — spawnable area overlay
